title: Technical Product & Project Manager
description:
**About the job:**


 We're hiring a
 
**Technical Product \& Project Manager** 

 to help turn client requirements into well\-defined products and make sure those products are delivered successfully. You'll work across product management, project management, client communication, delivery, and rapid prototyping.
 





 This is a
 
**full\-time** 

 ,
 
**work\-from\-office** 

 role in
 
**Hyderabad** 

 for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of business, product, design, technology, and delivery.
 




  




**About us:** 


 We're a new age tech \& business services company. We're HQ'ed in Hyderabad with clients across the world. Find out more about us at
 
 https://www.linkedin.com/company/gitforce
 



  




**What You'll Do** 

*TL;DR:* 

 Understand what clients need, define what needs to be built, work closely with engineers to get it built, and take ownership of delivering the final outcome.
 



* Work with clients and business stakeholders to understand requirements, workflows, problems, and desired outcomes
* Translate business requirements into clear product requirements, user stories, PRDs, and acceptance criteria
* Define product scope, priorities, milestones, deliverables, and success criteria
* Take ownership of project delivery from initial requirements through final implementation
* Work closely with engineers to clarify requirements, answer questions, and keep development moving
* Make sure projects are progressing as expected and proactively address issues that could impact delivery
* Coordinate across engineers, designers, clients, and other stakeholders to keep everyone aligned
* Regularly communicate project status, demos, risks, decisions, and next steps to clients
* Gather client feedback and translate it into clear, actionable changes for the engineering team
* Create quick prototypes, mockups, and proof\-of\-concepts using AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Replit, Lovable, or similar
* Identify gaps, edge cases, usability issues, and unclear requirements early in the development process
* Maintain clear documentation around requirements, project status, decisions, scope changes, and delivery
* Help ensure the final product is functional, usable, polished, and ready for the client





 ﻿
 




**Qualifications** 

*TL;DR:* 

 We're looking for someone who can understand business problems, define products clearly, work effectively with engineers, manage delivery, and use modern AI tools to rapidly turn ideas into prototypes.
 




**You Are:** 



* 2 to 5 years into your career in product management, project management, business analysis, software delivery, or a similar role
* Someone who is comfortable working with both business stakeholders and software engineers
* Comfortable taking ownership of a project from requirements through delivery
* Highly organized and able to keep multiple moving pieces on track
* Comfortable working through ambiguity and turning unclear ideas into clear requirements and action items
* Technically curious and able to understand how modern software applications are built
* Someone who enjoys using AI tools to rapidly turn ideas into working prototypes
* Comfortable presenting work in progress and discussing tradeoffs directly with clients
* Someone who cares about the quality and usability of the final product, not just whether tasks were completed
* Someone with a good eye for design, user experience, and how software should feel to use



**Must\-haves:** 



* Experience gathering and documenting business and product requirements
* Experience writing PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, or similar product documentation
* Experience working directly with software engineering teams
* Strong project management and delivery skills
* Ability to track tasks, milestones, dependencies, blockers, risks, and timelines
* Ability to take ownership of delivery and drive projects through completion
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Ability to communicate business requirements clearly to engineers
* Comfortable presenting product demos, progress updates, and project status to clients
* Strong problem\-solving and organizational skills
* Comfortable using AI tools and AI coding agents to create prototypes and proof\-of\-concepts
* Basic understanding of APIs, databases, frontend/backend applications, and modern software development
* Good product judgment and attention to user experience



**Nice\-to\-haves:** 



* Previous experience as a software engineer, business analyst, technical product manager, or technical project manager
* Experience working in a consulting or client services environment
* Strong visual and product design sense
* Experience creating wireframes, mockups, or prototypes using Figma or similar tools
* Experience with AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Replit, Lovable, or similar
* Experience with tools such as Jira, Linear, Asana, Notion, or similar
* Familiarity with SQL and basic data analysis
* Experience working on AI, analytics, or software engineering projects

**Job Description**
 As a Direct Materials Productivity Manager here at Honeywell, you will be responsible for driving productivity improvements and cost efficiencies in the direct materials supply chain. Your role will focus on optimizing procurement strategies, enhancing supplier performance, and ensuring the seamless flow of materials to support manufacturing and operational objectives. You will leverage your expertise in supply chain management and data analytics to identify opportunities for cost reduction and process enhancement, contributing directly to Honeywell’s competitive advantage and profitability.
   

  

 You will report directly to the Senior Director Procurement for Process Automation and you’ll work out from one our India locations (Bangalore/Hyderabed/Pune) on a Hybrid work schedule.
   

  

 In this role, you will impact Honeywell’s operational efficiency by leading initiatives that improve material cost productivity, reduce waste, and strengthen supplier partnerships. Your leadership will ensure that material availability aligns with production demands while maintaining cost targets and quality standards, thereby supporting the company’s overall business goals.
   

  

 Your role also include overseeing, supervising and reviewing tasks performed by team members to ensure effective execution of work; managing end to end processes and project for both internal and external clients with responsibility for timely accurate delivery; issuing clear instructions and directions to team members on task to be performed; and monitoring and guiding junior colleagues to support their skills development, professional growth, and overall success.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement direct materials productivity strategies aligned with business objectives to drive cost savings and operational efficiencies.
* Responsible for execution of productivity projects and achieving Gross Productivity and Net Productivity Annual Operating Plan (AOP) targets
* Responsible for developing a pipeline of productivity projects working cross\-functionally with strategic sourcing, factory operations, engineering, offering management and suppliers globally
* Responsible for achieving the productivity targets for all the levers i.e. Negotiations, Value Engineering, Component Engineering, Rebates and Deflation with the objective of achieving Gross Productivity and Net Productivity targets
* Analyze procurement data and supplier performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and cost reduction opportunities.
* Analyze spend receipts data and find opportunities for cost savings working closely with supplier sourcing leaders and procurement operations
* Collaborate closely with procurement, engineering, manufacturing, and quality teams to optimize material specifications, sourcing strategies, and inventory management.
* Lead supplier engagement initiatives to improve cost competitiveness.
* Manage cross\-functional projects focused on waste reduction, process improvements, and supply chain optimization.
* Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to direct materials productivity and cost savings to senior leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, or other methodologies to enhance supply chain processes.
* Support the development and deployment of procurement tools and technologies to improve data visibility and decision\-making.
* Mentor and develop team members to build capabilities in materials productivity and supply chain excellence.


**Qualifications**
**YOU MUST HAVE**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience in direct materials productivity or supply chain management roles.
* Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a proactive approach to driving change.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, cross\-functional team environment.


**WE VALUE**
* Proven experience in managing direct materials procurement and productivity within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and drive actionable insights.
* Expertise in supplier management, contract negotiation, and cost reduction strategies.
* Proficiency with ERP systems, procurement software, and data analysis tools.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and managing projects that deliver measurable productivity improvements.


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

Ensure project plan alignment with portfolio and product lifecycle management (PLM) goals.

This role acts as the functional lead to ensure that technology\-enabled solutions align closely with evolving R\&D needs, leveraging a strong working knowledge of pharmaceutical R\&D workflows, data and applicable concepts to effectively coordinate with external vendors, internal data science and digital teams. This role focuses on functional leadership and facilitation, responsible for working with the Chief Scientific Officer and science department heads to ensure streamlined processes are in place for meeting yearly KPIs, identifying process improvement \& simplification opportunities.
   

  

 The scope includes financial governance, reporting, resource planning, and process improvement. An ideal candidate will have experience with leading complex programs within the pharmaceutical development lifecycle, in addition to experience with CMO/CRO/lab operations. A deep understanding of project plans, budgeting / forecasting is a key attribute. This is a collaborative role involving significant engagement with cross\-functional heads (such as Quality, finance, accounting, legal and IT), to drive programs and ensure adoption. This role will have the exciting and unique opportunity to drive Management System excellence and adoption within our growing Hyderabad organization. The ideal candidate will be a quick learner who can work in an extremely fast paced organization and pivot from one objective to the next quickly.
   

  

**Principle Responsibilities**
* A) Lead project management
* Enable preparation and management of CSO\-R\&D budget, yearly KPIs and project plans. Enable project managers to identify, document and manage critical path activities. Review project plans, challenge project schedule baseline and assumptions. Ensure project managers have defined all activities with appropriate timelines, costs, risks and mitigation plans aligned with the project stakeholders.
* Through the project managers, prepare month\-on\-month project forecasts and manage CSO\-level variance between forecast vs. actual within thresholds. Facilitate budget decisions and deliverables throughout the yearly cycle. Support the R\&D head and science department heads in articulating decisions required, risks and layout options at appropriate level of depth to enable decisions.
* Enable project plan updation in A3 templates for all projects. Support the Franchise Portfolio Management and finance leadership with timeline, and cost evaluations when requested. Responsible for project status reporting to R\&D scientific leadership team (SLT), Strategic Portfolio Management and other project stakeholders as required. Maintain management information systems on budget, timelines, key risks, and decisions.
* Partner with the finance leadership and co\-own the Long\-Range Budget forecast, responsible for R\&D opex, capex, and product\-level development cost. Align science department leadership on the stage\-wise Probability of Technical \& Regulatory success.
* B) Management systems \& processes:

Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (internal/external) to track key performance indicators
* Develop/maintain collaboration and nurture relationships with internal partner functions and external entities as required, to support business and strategic goals. Serve as the point person for initial escalation, conflict resolution, project risk mitigation for issues that cannot be resolved in the Project Teams, requiring liaising with department leaders
* Oversight, mentoring, training of PM team members on policies and procedures
* Support R\&D operational planning \- Lab space management, capex \& support internal preparedness for QA audits, leadership visits.
* Responsible for drafting the R\&D sections in management presentations, working with the department heads and the Chief Scientific Officer.
* C) Digital enablement initiatives:
* Lead a small team of PMs and manage the R\&D digital budget, including annual subscriptions for off\-the\-shelf solutions as well as custom built solutions (external as well as in\-house).
* Champion the evaluation of cutting\-edge data tools and data\-enabled solutions by working alongside internal digital, data science and technical teams to ensure deliverables meeting R\&D’s strategic goals
* Lead end\-to\-end digital transformations from vendor selection to rollout, engaging with IT, cross functional teams and external vendors. Wherever optimal, lead in\-house workflow creation and execution through the IT team.
* Serve as the internal business owner to the Azurity IT team, on R\&D / laboratory systems such as E\-Lab Notebook, Document mgmt. system. Drive functional oversight on integration projects involving lab systems, ensuring alignment with R\&D workflows

The engineer shall review shop drawings, method statements, material submittals, hydraulic calculations, and construction schedules to ensure compliance with project requirements and applicable codes and standards.

 The role also involves supporting authority inspections, assisting in project handover documentation, and ensuring all systems are installed and commissioned in accordance with local regulations and client requirements. Experience in Data Centre, Commercial Building, Industrial, Infrastructure, Healthcare, or Mission Critical Facility projects is preferred.
